title: Preservation of selected head positions
statement: Let $m,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $\iota$ embed the indices of $m$ tapes into those of $k$ tapes, and let $c$ be an $m$-tape configuration. After embedding $c$ into $k$ tapes with any supplied tape contents, head positions, and output prefix, the head position on the tape indexed by $\iota(i)$ equals the head position on tape $i$ in $c$, for every $i<m$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
